entities.name: Diana Der Hovanessian
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Diana Der Hovanessian was an Armenian American poet, translator, and author. Much of the subject of her poetry was about Armenia and the Armenian diaspora. She wrote and published over twenty-five books.
